title: Polynomial-Time Packing of Fields
statement: Let $j$ and $p$ be polynomial-time computable functions from bit strings to bit strings, and let $q$ be a natural number. The function sending $z$ to the pair encoding of $j(z)$ with the pair encoding of $p(z)$ and the unary string of length $q$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced:
If two word functions are polynomial-time computable, then for every fixed phase
tag so is the function packing their values into an encoded seam word.
